firstConcreteRemainingBoundary.statement: The emitter remediation is complete and tested but cannot be pushed. GitHub secret scanning rejects any branch containing 546bd2c5, which carries five credential-shaped strings in scripts/tests/run-secret-detector.test.mjs lines 36-46 (Doppler, Supabase, Slack, Stripe, Twilio).
firstConcreteRemainingBoundary.whyNotBypassed: The file header asserts the values are synthetic. That is a comment asserting safety -- the same evidence class as a measuredFacts field asserting a measurement, which is the defect this entire block exists to close. Bypassing push protection on strings that cannot be independently proven fake is not a decision an agent should make silently.
firstConcreteRemainingBoundary.consequence: 546bd2c5 now has three independent defects: a false top-level verdict, fabricated throughput values in generated receipts, and unpushable content.
firstConcreteRemainingBoundary.durableFix: Generate credential-shaped fixtures at test runtime rather than storing literals, so push protection cannot fire on them again.
firstConcreteRemainingBoundary.decisionRequired: Operator: confirm synthetic and allowlist, or treat as real and rotate.
